description:
Mapjects is seeking to extend the sensor resolution on some of the Mapjects scanners (either windows CE  or mobile or Android)
 

 For example the candidate should be able to configure the equipment programmatically.
 

 If the candidate is qualified, a possible remote option maybe available, after the first 3 weeks.

 C++ or C# windows SDK mobile or Embedded

 please email word copy of resume to 
 ensure it has your contact information, and phone number to reach you. 
 
 dev@mapjects.com  or jobs@mapjects.com
